history.summary: A Hindu temple listed at Aizawl 796017 (southern Aizawl), with two independent place datasets agreeing on coordinates 23.7435, 92.7419; ~4.6 rating from ~15 online reviews. No published source gives its founding date, builder, presiding deity, or history — the name suggests a shrine centred on the sacred syllable Om, but this is inference, not evidence. The only image-search hit for 'OM Mandir Aizawl' was actually Solomon's Temple (a Christian church) and was excluded; no reliable photograph of this temple was found after genuine searching, so media is left empty.

name: OM Mandir
town_description: Aizawl is the capital of Mizoram, a hill city built on steep ridges at around 1,130 m elevation in the state's northern hills. Overwhelmingly Christian (Mizo) in population, it is the political, commercial and cultural centre of the state, with a small Hindu minority of Gorkha, Bihari and other non-Mizo communities who maintain the city's handful of temples.

travel.airport: Lengpui Airport, ~35 km northwest of Aizawl (verify).
travel.road: Aizawl is connected to Silchar (~180 km) and Guwahati (~450 km) by NH-6; city taxis within town (verify).
